IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight brown hair and drop earrings
stands in a snowy landscape. She wears
a dark textured velvet jacket with a high
mock collar and dark embroidered trim,
with a pendant necklace at her throat.
Her hands rest at her waist. Her
expression is calm and distant. Cool,
overcast light with a blurred pine treeline
behind her. Palette of slate blue,
charcoal, and snow white. Moody and
wintry, in the style of a cinematic winter
film still.
